My braces came off while I was on a business trip to Bangkok, and despite my short notice, they were able to help me. 
A Japanese woman acted as an interpreter, which made me feel very at ease. Thank you so much!

restaurant_name: 富士JDC歯科医院 CITI RESORT 39店
text: I highly recommend this clinic. It was my first time at the dentist in about 35 years, and I was worried that detailed explanations would be troublesome if they were in a language other than Japanese, but there seems to be a Japanese speaker permanently stationed at the reception here. The doctor speaks broken Japanese, but the reception staff accompanies you to the examination room, so in terms of language, it's no different from being in Japan. The examination also started only after I was satisfied with the detailed treatment methods, future plans, and total cost explained in conversation during the first visit. The doctor's skills are also excellent, and although it's difficult for me to judge since it's been 35 years, I think it's probably quite good in terms of price, skill, and Japanese language support.

restaurant_name: 富士JDC歯科医院 CITI RESORT 39店
text: I was on a business trip away from home and suddenly had a toothache. I was worried about going to the dentist in a foreign country, but the reception staff and the doctor here were very kind and helpful. The treatment was almost painless, and I was able to receive treatment with peace of mind. I would like to use this clinic for regular checkups in the future. Thank you very much.

text:
My tooth filling came out, so I had it refilled.
After the procedure was finished, I was told to wait two minutes for the adhesive to dry, and was left alone for five minutes while I talked to the doctor next to me.
Three hours after the procedure, the filling came out again.
I called to ask if they could do it again, but they insisted they were fully booked that night and couldn't do it.
They charged THB 1,500 for the procedure, so isn't this justified?
